CHAIRMAN’S STATEMENT



本人欣然向各位股東提呈本公司及本集團二零                     I am pleased to present to shareholders the business review and
二一年十二月三十一日止之年度業績回顧與展望。                   outlook of the Company and the Group for the year ended 31
                                         December 2021.

二零二一年，中國沉著應對百年變局和世紀疫情，                   In 2021, China coped with unprecedented global changes and the
構建新發展格局邁出新步伐，高質量發展取得新                    epidemic steadily, promoted a new economic growth pattern and
成效，國內生產總值再破人民幣百萬億元，同比                    achieved high-quality growth. China’s GDP in 2021 exceeded
增長 8.1%，社會消費品零售總額人民幣 44.1 萬億             RMB100 trillion for another year, or 8.1% growth YoY. The total
元，同比增長 12.5%，中國經濟展現了強大的活                 retail sales of consumer goods reached RMB44.1 trillion, representing
力和韌性。                                    a YoY growth of 12.5%. Chinese economy has shown its strong
                                         vitality and resilience.

二零二一年，中國房地產行業在去槓桿的過程中                    In 2021, Chinese property sector experienced profound
經歷了深刻的調整變革，市場波動加劇風險提升。                   transformations with increasing market volatility and risks during
本集團秉持長期主義的經營理念，提升抗周期能                    deleveraging process. With long-term business vision, the Group
力，持續踐行為股東創造價值的承諾。年內，本                    enhanced its counter-cyclical capability and continued to fulfill its
集團各項核心業績指標實現穩健增長。全年實現                    commitment to create value for shareholders. During the year, the
綜合營業額人民幣 2,121 億元，按年增長 18.1%，            Group’s core businesses delivered stable growth. Consolidated

8.7%，核心股東應佔溢利人民幣 266 億元，按年               profit attributable to the shareholders of the Company and core net

公司執行董事及高級管理人員薪酬由基本工資、         The total remuneration of executive Directors and senior management
績效獎金及中長期激勵三部分構成，公司按照年         comprises three key components, namely basic salary, bonus and the
度及更長周期確定業績與戰略目標，並基於目標         mid-to-long term incentive scheme. The Company sets its strategic
向執行董事及高級管理人員分派任務，並按照設         and performance targets on an annual and long-term basis. Based on
定的衡量標準與方法進行考核。績效獎金根據年         the Company’s overall performance targets, the Company assigns
度績效考核結果確定，促進年度業績目標達成，         responsibilities and sets performance benchmarks and evaluation
中長期激勵與公司中長期戰略目標關聯，根據戰         methods for each executive Director and members of the senior
略週期考核結果確定，實現企業經營管理者與企         management team. To promote the achievement of annual
業所有者利益的統一，促進公司健康發展。           performance goals, actual performance is assessed against annual
                              performance targets in order to determine the bonus. To align the
                              interests of owners and management team of the Company and
                              promote healthy development of the Company, the mid-to-long term
                              incentive scheme is correlated with mid-to-long term strategic targets
                              of the Company and determined by evaluating the performance in
                              corresponding strategical period.

於回顧年度，薪酬委員會已檢討執行董事薪酬之         During the year under review, the Remuneration Committee has

     公平值計量                                    FAIR VALUE MEASUREMENT

     公平值為於計量當日在市場參與者之間於有                      Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an asset or
     序交易中出售資產所收取或轉讓負債所支付                      paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between
     的價格，不管該價格是否可直接觀察得到或                      market participants at the measurement date, regardless of
     使用另一估值技巧而估計。於估計資產或負                      whether that price is directly observable or estimated using
     債的公平值時，倘市場參與者於計量當日為                      another valuation technique. In estimating the fair value of an
     資產或負債定價時將會考慮的資產或負債的                      asset or a liability, the Group takes into account the
     特點時，則本集團會考慮該等特點。                         characteristics of the asset or liability if market participants
                                              would take those characteristics into account when pricing the
                                              asset or liability at the measurement date.

     非金融資產公平值之計量則參考市場參與者                      A fair value measurement of a non-financial asset takes into
     可從使用該資產得到之最高及最佳效用，或                      account a market participant’s ability to generate economic
     把該資產售予另一可從使用該資產得到最高                      benefits by using the asset in its highest and best use or by
     及最佳效用之市場參與者所產生之經濟效益。                     selling it to another market participant that would use the asset
                                              in its highest and best use.

     此外，就財務報告而言，公平值計量乃根據                      In addition, for financial reporting purposes, fair value
     公平值計量輸入數據的可觀察程度及公平值                      measurements are categorised into Level 1, 2 or 3 based on the
     計量輸入數據的整體重要性而劃分為第一                       degree to which the inputs to the fair value measurements are
     級、第二級或第三級，詳述如下：                          observable and the significance of the inputs to the fair value

     •   第一級   輸入數據為該實體可於計量當                  •   Level 1    inputs are quoted prices (unadjusted) in active
               日自相同資產或負債的活躍市                                 markets for identical assets or liabilities that the
               場取得的報價（未經調整）；                                 entity can access at the measurement date;

     •   第二級   輸入數據為第一級內所載報價                  •   Level 2    inputs are inputs, other than quoted prices
               以外就資產或負債可直接或間                                 included within Level 1, that are observable for
               接觀察的輸入數據；及                                    the asset or liability, either directly or indirectly;
                                                             and

     •   第三級   輸入數據為就資產或負債而無                  •   Level 3    inputs are unobservable inputs for the asset or
               法觀察的輸入數據。                                     liability.

     本集團無法輕易釐定租賃內所隱含的利率，                    The Group cannot readily determine the interest rate implicit in
     因此，使用增量借款利率計量租賃負債。增                    a lease, and therefore, it uses an incremental borrowing rate
     量借款利率為本集團於類似經濟環境中為取                    (“IBR”) to measure lease liabilities. The IBR is the rate of interest
     得與使用權資產價值相近之資產，而以類似                    that the Group would have to pay to borrow over a similar
     抵押品與類似期間借入所需資金應支付之利                    term, and with a similar security, the funds necessary to obtain
     率。因此，增量借款利率反映了本集團「應                    an asset of a similar value to the right-of-use asset in a similar
     支付」的利率，當無可觀察的利率時（如就                    economic environment. The IBR therefore reflects what the
     並無訂立融資交易之附屬公司而言）或當須                    Group “would have to pay”, which requires estimation when
     對利率進行調整以反映租賃之條款及條件                     no observable rates are available (such as for subsidiaries that
     時，則須作出利率估計。當可觀察輸入數據                    do not enter into financing transactions) or when it needs to be
     可用時，本集團使用可觀察輸入數據（如市                    adjusted to reflect the terms and conditions of the lease. The
     場利率）估算增量借款利率並須作出若干實                    Group estimates the IBR using observable inputs (such as market
     體特定的估計（如附屬公司的獨立信用評級）
                        。                   interest rates) when available and is required to make certain
                                            entity-specific estimates (such as the subsidiary’s stand-alone
                                            credit rating).

  附註：                              Notes:

  (a)   本集團的估值程序                   (a)      Valuation processes of the Group

         本集團按公平值對其投資物業進行計量。本集               The Group measures its investment properties at fair value. The fair
         團投資物業於二零二一年十二月三十一日及二               value of the Group’s investment properties as at 31 December 2021
         零二零年十二月三十一日的公平值是根據世邦               and as at 31 December 2020 has been determined on the basis of
         魏理仕有限公司及泓亮諮詢及評估有限公司                valuation carried out by CBRE Limited and Vincorn Consulting and
        （均為獨立及專業合資格估值師）進行的估值而               Appraisal Limited, both are independent and professionally qualified
         釐定。                                valuers.

        管理層與估值師每六個月最少對估值過程及結                Discussions of valuation processes and results are held between
        果進行一次討論，以配合本集團之中期及年度                management and valuers at least once every six months, in line with
        報告時間。                               the timing of Group’s interim and annual reporting.

  (b)   估值技術                       (b)      Valuation techniques

        估值採用之估值方法包括已落成物業所用的收                The valuation methodologies adopted in valuations include income
        益法及╱或直接比較法，在建物業所用的剩餘                approach and/or direct comparison approach for completed properties
        法、直接比較法及╱或成本法，以及使用權資                and residual approach, direct comparison approach and/or cost
        產所用之收益法。                            approach for the properties under construction and income approach
                                            for the right-of-use assets.

        收益法通過計算物業當前租約的租金收入，並                The income approach operates by taking into account the rental
        計算出租及空置部份的潛在租金收入，然後按                income of the property derived from the existing tenancies with due
        合適的資本化率將其資本化為價值。                    allowance for the potential reversionary income of the tenanted and
                                            vacant portions, which are then capitalised at an appropriate
                                            capitalisation rate.

        直接比較法涉及分析近期巿場上同類型物業的                The direct comparison approach involves the analysis of recent market
        案例並與該等估值物業進行比較。選取面積大                evidence of similar properties and comparing them with the premises
        小、屬性及位置類近的可資比較物業進行分                 under valuation. Comparable properties with similar sizes, characters
        析，並仔細權衡各物業的優劣之處，從而達至                and locations are analysed, and carefully weighed against all
        公允的評估價值。                            respective advantage and disadvantages of each property in order to
                                            arrive at a fair comparison of value.

        剩餘法考慮總發展價值並扣除尚未發生的建築                The residual approach takes into account the residual value of the
        成本、開支以及發展利潤後的剩餘價值。剩餘                gross development value (“GDV”) after deduction of the outstanding
        法首先計算假設建議發展項目於估值日已落成                construction costs and expenses as well as profit element. It involves
        的合計總發展價值。建議發展項目的估計成本                firstly the assessment of the aggregate GDV of the proposed
        包括建築成本、市場推廣支出、專業費用、財                development, as if completed, as at the valuation date. Estimated
        務費用以及相關成本，另加發展商的風險及利                costs of the proposed development include construction costs,
        潤撥備。尚未發生的開發成本將由總發展價值                marketing expense, professional fee, finance charges and associated
        中扣除，並得出標的物業的剩餘價值。                   costs, plus an allowance for the developer’s risk and profit. The
                                            outstanding development costs are then deducted from the GDV and
                                            the resultant figure is the residual value of the subject property.

        成本法採用總重置成本以得出標的物業於估值                The cost approach is a method of using gross replacement costs to
        日現狀的價值。成本法需要估算該土地現值，                arrive at the value of the subject property in its existing state as at the
        另加該土地上改造工程的重置成本估算。改造                valuation date. The cost approach requires estimates of the current
        工程重置成本包括建築工程成本、地盤工程成                value of the land plus the estimated replacement costs of the land
        本、財務費用及工程相關成本。                      improvement works. The replacement costs of the improvement
                                            works includes the costs of the building work, site works, finance
                                            charges and relevant associated costs.

        於估計物業公平值時，物業的最高及最佳用途                In estimating the fair value of the properties, the highest and best use
        為其現時用途。                             of the properties is their current use.

   該結餘是指從中國內地一家信譽良好的持牌                      The balance represents deposit certificates purchased from a
   銀 行 購 買 的 大 額 存 款 單， 固 定 年 利 率 為         creditworthy licensed bank in Mainland China earning interest
   3.5%，原訂期限為 36 個月。大額存單於持                  at a fixed rate of 3.5% per annum with original maturity period
   有超過三個月時可予以贖回。定期存款的合                      of 36 months. The deposit certificates are redeemable upon
   同條款規定於特定日期產生的現金流量僅為                      holding for longer than three months. The contractual terms of
   對本金及未償還本金利息的付款，並按目標                      the time deposits give rise on specified dates to cash flows are
   為持有及獲取合同現金流量的業務模式持                       solely payments of principal and interest on the principal
   有。因此，定期存款入賬列作按攤餘成本計                      amount outstanding and are held within a business model with
   量的金融資產。                                  the objective to hold in order to collect contractual cash flows.

  保持一致。                                     of the debt and equity balance. The Group’s overall strategy

51. 退休福利計劃                   51. RETIREMENT BENEFIT SCHEMES

   本集團為駐香港僱員參與強制性公積金計劃          The Group participates in a mandatory provident fund scheme
  （「強積金計劃」）。強積金計劃為根據強制性         (“MPF Scheme”) for its employees in Hong Kong. The MPF
   公積金計劃條例原則制訂的界定供款計劃。          Scheme is a defined contribution scheme in accordance with
   根據強積金計劃規則，僱主及僱員須按僱員          the principle of the Mandatory Provident Fund Scheme
   薪金 5% 供款，每月供款上限為每名僱員港        Ordinance. Under the rules of MPF Scheme, the employer and
   幣 1,500 元。強積金計劃資產由獨立管理基      its employees are required to contribute 5% of the employee’s
   金持有，與集團公司資產分開持有。             salaries, up to a maximum of HK$1,500 per employee per
                                month. The assets of the MPF Scheme are held separately from
                                those of the group companies in an independently administered
                                fund.

  本集團於中國之僱員為中國各地方政府經營           The employees of the Group in the PRC are members of state-
  的國家管理退休福利計劃之成員。本集團須           managed retirement benefit schemes operated by the respective
  按特定薪金成本百分比向計劃作指定供款，           local government in the PRC. The Group is required to
  作為福利計劃之資金。本集團就該等計劃之           contribute a specified percentage of payroll costs to the
  唯一責任為作出指定供款。                  schemes to fund the benefits. The only obligation of the Group
                                with respect to these schemes is to make the specified
                                contributions.
